sbom_generation_context.purpose: Demonstrate packaging of a synthetic SBOM against CISA 2026 minimum elements for a bounded review sample.
sbom_generation_context.sbom_format: CycloneDX JSON (sample-shaped, not a full tooling export guarantee)
scope_notes: Covers a tiny synthetic application and three sample libraries only.
Does not represent a full monorepo, container image, SaaS multi-tenant surface, or AI model stack.
Hashes and licenses for gap-demo components are intentionally incomplete to exercise the checklist.

cisa_reference.title: 2026 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
cisa_reference.publisher: CISA with U.S. and international partners
cisa_reference.relationship_to_sample: Referenced as the public minimum-elements baseline this sample checklist maps against. The sample does not certify compliance with CISA guidance.
